plan.title: bug(routing): swarm:routing-set fails containment in linked worktrees

narratives.Description: bug(routing): swarm:routing-set fails containment in linked worktrees
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Inside a Git linked worktree, `task swarm:routing-set` resolves `.deft/routing.local.json` in the primary worktree but validates containment against the linked worktree root. The command therefore refuses its own resolved target.

## Reproduction

1. Create a linked worktree beneath or beside the primary checkout.
2. Start a mutation session in that worktree.
3. Run `task swarm:routing-set -- --provider codex --role review-monitor --model gpt-5.6-sol`.

## Actual behavior

The command exits 2:

```text
ERROR: projection write refused: target <primary>/.deft/routing.local.json is not nested under the project tree <linked-worktree>
```

## Expected behavior

The routing path and containment root should agree so a linked-worktree session can record the required pre-dispatch model decision without writing outside its authorized project boundary.

## Environment and evidence

- Reproduced on current `upstream/master` at `c99f6159`.
- Discovered while implementing #3612 in a dedicated linked worktree.
- #3807 covers linked-worktree hook target classification; this failure is in the routing-set write path.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Inside a Git linked worktree, `task swarm:routing-set` resolves `.deft/routing.local.json` and validates containment against the same project root so the command can record the pre-dispatch model decision.
- [ ] The command does not refuse a target it resolved because the containment root and resolved path disagree across the primary checkout and the linked worktree.
- [ ] Regression tests cover a linked-worktree session that previously exited 2 with `projection write refused: target <primary>/.deft/routing.local.json is not nested under the project tree <linked-worktree>`.
- [ ] Pass the full framework check and document the fix in CHANGELOG.md.
